messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Incident detected: elevated error rate and health-check flapping for canary variant 'redwood-gpt-s-v3-q4' in ap-southeast-1. Fallback engaged: sticky -> default-stable. Pager: oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Pulling the canary health timeline.

Skyler: Seeing 502s and repeated health-check toggles. Canary nodes reporting `kv-format-mismatch` and `model-load-retry`.

Priya: The release manifest shows a change to kv-shard layout in v3 packaging. That could explain mismatches.

DevOpsLead: Pause the rollout and un-sticky fallback if possible to prevent long-lived pinning. Command to pause: `redwood rollout pause --name canary-v3-0912`. Command to set emergency fallback mode: `redwood policy set --id canary-v3-0912 --fallback-mode=ephemeral --fallback-ttl=30s`.

oncall-sre: Executing pause now.

incident-bot: Action: rollout pause started (job=job-3345).

EngRelease: Quick note: we intentionally changed the kv layout to improve cache locality; we missed a compatibility shim for older runtime. Prep a hotfix ASAP.

Skyler: If we flip fallback to ephemeral, clients will re-evaluate routing quickly. That helps avoid sessions staying stuck on incompatible variant, but might create retries. We should also shift traffic to another healthy region to reduce retry storms.

DevOpsLead: Good call. Plan: 1) pause canary, 2) set fallback to ephemeral 30s, 3) soft-route customer-tier=prod to ap-southeast-2 stable pool, 4) coordinate release repack.

SupportLead: I'll draft customer comms and flag any VIP accounts. Support is seeing a small number of complaints about 'session failures' from APAC customers.

oncall-sre: Changing fallback policy now: `redwood policy update --id canary-v3-0912 --fallback-mode=ephemeral --fallback-ttl=30s`.

incident-bot: Policy update successful. Fallback TTL now 30s.

DevOpsLead: Applying soft cross-region route: `redwood route modify --from ap-southeast-1 --to ap-southeast-2 --selector customer-tier=prod --weight=100 --soft=true`

incident-bot: Route change applied. Expected RTT increase ~40ms for affected flows. Monitoring will show traffic shift.

Skyler: After route change, error rate in ap-southeast-1 dropped to baseline. ap-southeast-2 healthy. No infra reboots observed.

Priya: Creating ticket INC-1182: "Canary packaging introduced incompatible KV layout causing health-check failures". Assigning to EngRelease.

EngRelease: Pulling a repack with compatibility shim. ETA 45m for build+smoke. Will push to canary after verification.

SupportLead: Notifying account teams for impacted customers, adding troubleshooting steps to internal KB.

Skyler: Observability note: sticky-fallback interactions weren't flagged by rollout guardrails. Recommend a preflight test that validates kv-compat across runtime versions before rolling.

oncall-sre: Agreed. Also adding an automated detector rule for `kv-format-mismatch` errors to fail rollouts immediately.

DevOpsLead: Ops decision: keep fallback ephemeral for now. Once repack passes, we will re-run rollout with compatibility flag on and longer health stabilisation window.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity S2. Actions taken: paused canary rollout, set ephemeral fallback T=30s, soft-routed prod traffic to ap-southeast-2, created INC-1182.

Skyler: Handoff: I'll remain on the page for 60 minutes to watch traffic and verify no regressions.

Priya: Once EngRelease posts the repack, run a dry-run canary in a QA pool, validate kv metrics: `kv-shard-count`, `kv-schema-version` and smoke test with representative prefixes.

EngRelease: Will run the dry-run and post logs + diff. If green, request unpause.

SupportLead: Tracking notes: about ~120 sessions had transient errors, most recovered after routing change. Support is reaching out to customers who reported failures.

DevOpsLead: Post-incident tasks: 1) add kv-compat check in CI, 2) add rollout guard for sticky fallback interactions, 3) update runbook for cross-region soft-route. Assigning follow-ups in INC-1182.

oncall-sre: Thanks team. Leaving watch with Skyler.

Skyler: Ending handoff to Priya after 60m watch.

DevOpsLead: Closing notes: no prolonged customer outages; root cause correlation: packaging kv-schema bump without runtime compatibility shim.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation; pending postmortem.
